scene: The doorway leads to a grand transit hub.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along a stone platform floor. On the far left sits a waiting glass funicular on slanted tracks. In the centre stands the bearded man in his blue cap and orange cardigan with his wooden cane. To his right bobs a green striped water taxi, and on the far right waits an open monorail.
shown: a glass-domed funicular railway car waiting on the far left
a striped water taxi bobbing in a canal channel on the right
a sleek suspended monorail car stationed open on the far right
